articles.title: Prince Harry and six others ordered to pay initial £9.5m to Daily Mail publisher
articles.description: The seven claimants, who include Sir Elton John and Liz Hurley, could potentially have to pay up to £25m more after losing their High Court privacy case.

articles.title: El Niño warming set to be 'strongest in living memory', warns Met Office
articles.description: Scientists say the "unprecedented event" will likely push up global temperatures in 2027 and put the UK at risk of a wetter, stormier autumn.

articles.title: Under-fives and pregnant women told to avoid runny eggs when eating out over salmonella risk
articles.description: The advice also applies to the over-65s and others with underlying medical conditions amid salmonella outbreak.

articles.title: Steve Rosenberg: Shortage of petrol but not patriotism as Russians feel growing impact of war
articles.description: Drivers are waiting hours in fuel queues, as Moscow prepares to celebrate Russian Flag Day.
